rule_notes.stalemate: Automatic draw when the player to move has no legal move and is not in check (FIDE 5.2.1).
rule_notes.insufficient_material: Automatic material-based dead-position detection: K vs K, K+B vs K, K+N vs K, and only kings/bishops with every bishop on the same square color (FIDE 5.2.2).
rule_notes.bishops: Only bishops remaining is not sufficient: bishops on both square colors can allow checkmate.
rule_notes.repetition: Three occurrences allow a claim; five occurrences end the game automatically (FIDE 9.2 and 9.6.1). Position identity includes side to move and legal-move rights.
rule_notes.move_count: 50 moves by each player without a pawn move or capture allow a claim (100 plies); 75 by each end automatically (150 plies). Checkmate takes precedence (FIDE 9.3 and 9.6.2).
rule_notes.claims: A claim may identify an intended legal move that completes the condition. AI claims are optional player policy; humans press D.
rule_notes.limitation: python-chess material detection does not prove every possible dead position, such as some blocked positions. This is not a complete FIDE tournament arbiter.
